subject: Issues using geom_tile to plot heatmaps

messages.author: 2401d0740178cf07
messages.subject: Issues using geom_tile to plot heatmaps
parts:
Dear list,

I am using geom_tiles to produce heatmaps that show monthly averages of soil humidity in several depths. I am creating two plots, dry and wet soil, in one single figure.

So far I managed to create the plots, but there are two issues I need to get rid of:

1) The vertical spacing is weird. I suspect this occurs because x-axis data is date, but I'm not sure about that (and have no idea on how to fix);
2) I would like to create a single y-axis label - soil depth (m) - for both graphics, but I don't know how to get that. 

Below is the code I am using to produce my plots. Does anyone have any suggestion to help me fix the issues?

--------------------------------------------------------------
# load packages to
require (RCurl)     # download remote data
require (reshape)   # reorganize data
require (ggplot2)   # produce graphics
require (scales)    # allow dates on graphic axis
require (gridExtra) # organize figures on grids

# read data
dry.link <- getURL('http://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/27700634/data.soil.dry.txt')
wet.link <- getURL('http://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/27700634/data.soil.wet.txt')

dry.soil <- read.csv(textConnection(dry.link), header=T, sep='')
wet.soil <- read.csv(textConnection(wet.link), header=T, sep='')

# get date from character
tmp1 <- paste(dry.soil$year, dry.soil$month, dry.soil$day, sep='/')
date <- as.Date(tmp1)

# add date amd remove old elements
dry.soil <- cbind(date, dry.soil)
wet.soil <- cbind(date, wet.soil)

dry.soil <- subset(dry.soil, select = -c(year,month,day,jday))
wet.soil <- subset(wet.soil, select = -c(year,month,day,jday))

# constraint date
dry.soil <- subset(dry.soil, as.Date(date) >= '2012-01-01' & as.Date(date) <= '2012-12-31') 
wet.soil <- subset(wet.soil, as.Date(date) >= '2012-01-01' & as.Date(date) <= '2012-12-31') 

# create month factor to produce average
dry.soil$monfac <- droplevels(cut(dry.soil$date, breaks='month'))
wet.soil$monfac <- droplevels(cut(wet.soil$date, breaks='month'))

# monthly averages
dry.df <- aggregate(cbind(soil_mois1, soil_mois2, soil_mois3,
                          soil_mois4, soil_mois5, soil_mois6,
                          soil_mois7, soil_mois8, soil_mois9,
                          soil_mois10, soil_mois11) ~ monfac, data=dry.soil, FUN='mean', na.action=na.pass)

wet.df <- aggregate(cbind(soil_mois1, soil_mois2, soil_mois3,
                          soil_mois4, soil_mois5, soil_mois6,
                          soil_mois7, soil_mois8, soil_mois9,
                          soil_mois10, soil_mois11) ~ monfac, data=wet.soil, FUN='mean', na.action=na.pass)

# melt data.frame by date
dry.soil.m <- melt(dry.df, id = c('monfac'))
dry.soil.m$monfac <- as.Date(dry.soil.m$monfac)
dry.soil.m <- ddply(dry.soil.m, .(variable), transform, rescale = rescale(value))

wet.soil.m <- melt(wet.df, id = c('monfac'))
wet.soil.m$monfac <- as.Date(wet.soil.m$monfac)
wet.soil.m <- ddply(wet.soil.m, .(variable), transform, rescale = rescale(value))

# rename levels names
depths <- c("0.05","0.10","0.20","0.30",
            "0.40","0.60","0.80","1.00",
            "1.50","2.00","2.50")

levels(dry.soil.m$variable) <- levels(wet.soil.m$variable) <- depths

# reverse order or levels to display a "cross-section" of the soil
dry.soil.m$variable = with(dry.soil.m, factor(variable, levels = rev(levels(variable))))

wet.soil.m$variable = with(wet.soil.m, factor(variable, levels = rev(levels(variable))))

# get data range to create legend
limits <- range (dry.soil.m$value, wet.soil.m$value)

# plot data
# based on http://learnr.wordpress.com/2010/01/26/ggplot2-quick-heatmap-plotting/
dry.p <- ggplot(dry.soil.m, aes(monfac, variable)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = value), colour = "white") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(limits= limits,
                      name= "Soil moisture \n(fraction)",
                      low= "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 22) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks("months"),
               labels = date_format("%b"),
               limits = as.Date(c('2012-01-01','2012-12-01'))) +
  labs(x='', y='')

wet.p <- ggplot(wet.soil.m, aes(monfac, variable)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = value), colour = "white") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(limits= limits,                      
                      low= "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 22) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks("months"),
               labels = date_format("%b"),
               limits = as.Date(c('2012-01-01','2012-12-01'))) +
  labs(x='', y='')

#extract legend
#https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Share-a-legend-between-two-ggplot2-graphs
#source: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13649473/add-a-common-legend-for-combined-ggplots
g_legend<-function(a.gplot){
  tmp <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(a.gplot))
  leg <- which(sapply(tmp$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  legend <- tmp$grobs[[leg]]
  return(legend)}

mylegend <- g_legend(dry.p)

# assemble figure
pp3 <- grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(dry.p + theme(legend.position="none"),
                                wet.p + theme(legend.position="none"),
                                ncol=1),
                    mylegend, nrow=1, widths=c(10, 2))
